commands.setCommand: LCDALIGNMENT mode x y updown leftright
rawDetails:
mode
  00: Execute adjustment (Specifying coordinate)
  01: LCD alignment correction setting
  02: Adjustment color setting
  03: Pattern color setting
  04: Execute adjustment (Overall adjustment)
  INIT  (Setting only)

x
  0000~270F (9999): Return x axis
y
  0000~270F (9999): Return y axis

mode
  00: Acquisition of adjustment value (Specifying coordinate)
  01: LCD alignment correction setting
  02: Adjustment color setting
  03: Pattern color setting

x
  0000~270F (9999): Return x axis
y
  0000~270F (9999): Return y axis

Acquisition of adjustment value  (when "00" specified)
Return the vertical adjustment value and the horizontal adjustment value

param
  - Acquisition of LCD alignment correction  (01)
     00: OFF
     01: ON
  - Acquisition of adjustment color  (02)
     01:  Red
     02:  Blue
  - Acquisition of pattern color  (03)
     01: R/G/B
     02: R/G
     03: G/B

ON : Flip horizontal
OFF: Normal position
INIT  (Setting only)

OFF: Normal position
